data.narrative:
Hades Mining is a Seed-stage frontier-tech company in the Climate & Energy sector founded by Max Werner, Björn Dressler, and Dan Gengenbach. The target has raised $22M to date. The Climate & Energy comp universe consists of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though a narrow peer set at identical stage and valuation tier yielded insufficient datapoints for statistical median analysis.

Valuation triangulation relies on a single applicable method: Stage-Progression. Using the $22M total capital raised as a base proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $55M. The Peer-Median method was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the Climate & Energy vertical meeting minimum threshold criteria (n≥3). Expanding the peer set across the full sector would introduce excessive methodological noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $47M (low) to $63M (high), with a median point of $55M. This single-method triangulation carries material uncertainty. Key risks include: (1) stage-progression multipliers may not hold given frontier-tech sector volatility and capital intensity; (2) insufficient narrow comparables limits calibration to true peer performance; and (3) undisclosed current valuation precludes validation against insider valuation signals. This range should be treated as indicative rather than definitive pending expansion of comparable transaction data or revenue/traction materialization.
